about: Shared naming table for src/lib/vcs/version-naming.ts and its ports (hiveku_agent_server app/services/version_name.py, hiveku-vscode src/versionName.ts). Every port must reproduce every expected value exactly. "paths" pins describePath (expected_route only for pages); "changes" pins describeChanges; "name_checks" pins isPlainVersionName (the check a port runs on a name an agent or a person typed before using it) and, on the rows that carry expected_without_byline, stripLegacyVersionPrefix: the trimmed name without the exact legacy agent byline in front ("Hiveku AI:" or "AI:", this spelling and case, removed once). A name that starts with the byline is never plain. The builder removes the byline only from names an agent or an API key sent (sources ai_turn, mcp), never from a person's own name (manual, editor_idle, vscode, sync_cli). "note" fields are commentary, never inputs. A generated name never contains a path or a file extension and is at most 80 characters. Change a rule and this table in the same commit, then re-run every port.
